lines.en: - Mom? - I know who I am.
I love you. Mother.
What, you think I don't love you?
- You never say it. - Well, it's not easy to say "I love you"
to a daughter who thinks I'm, you know, scummy.
I don't think you're scummy.
All the time.
Really?
Yeah, really.
- Blow the ram horn! - Blow the ram horn!
Good, good, good, faster!
- Dirty stock water! - Stock water!
- Ow! Fish to face! - Fish to face!
- Say hi to my twin sister, Melanie! - Hi, Melanie!
- Blow the ram's horn! - Ram's horn!
How could you make out with Freddy?
He's adorable!
- I can't believe you two are sisters. - Me either.
- Dude, I-- - He told me I'm one of a kind.
Yes, and my dad once told my mom he was coming back.
- So, moving on. - You can't leave this place without permission from a parent.
- Dude, my mom's in Tijuana having laser hair removal.
- Where's your father? - You tell me!
If my dad asked me to spend some time with him in Italy, I'd say...
Well, first I'd say, "Oh, so you're my dad."
- And then I'd go. - See, my dad wants the contest to be a brain buster.
You know, something you really gotta figure out.
Oh, like how many of Sam's relatives are on parole?
Hey, don't go bagging on my Aunt Maggie, Cousin Garth, and Uncle Morris, all right?
- Isn't your Uncle Buzz on parole, too? - No, look, Benson.
- What, Sam? Stop it! - You know, he's a nice guy.
- Stop it! - Uncle Carmine!
- Hey! - Hey!
- What's up, Chaz? - Ah, the same old.
- Uh, this your new fella? - Oh, the B.F.
Oh, yeah.
Freddie, this is my Uncle Carmine and my cousin Chaz.
Freddie Benson.
Delightful to meet you guys.
Hey, you just be good to our little Sammy.
Oh, we'll stab you all over.
What up, party people?
Say hello to my cousin, Annie.
Hi, I thought you said she was in jail.
Oh, parole baby.
Ready, Freddie?
Ready for what?
Annie's a tattoo artist.
Now, you can't have a real art exhibit without music, right?
So, say hello to Sam's cousin.
The one who's not in jail.
Our friend, Greg Patelio!
Hey, Carly. Hi, Sam.
- Hey, dude. - Hi, Greg.
Why don't you crank up that flute and get this art exhibit started?
- Yeah, baby. - Yeah, baby.
Here we go.
How was that?
It's a little bit boring.
Now, show him how we do it iCarly style.
Hurry, Greg.
He's playing the flute.
And beatboxes.
- At the same time. - All by himself.
- My cousin has got tennis! - Yeah, baby!
Yeah! Woo!
It looks real.
Yeah, it's a real gigantic piece of plastic pie
with a camera lens on the side.
Ah! Look, it comes with a giant fork!
Give it!
This is a quality piece of spy equipment.
My Aunt Maggie's boobs look more real than that.
And they're ridiculous.
- Check out what I found! - What is that?
It looks like something my Aunt Maggie would cough up.
Well, she's a smoker!
Better way.
There.
- How do I look? - Chunky and lumpy.
Just like my Aunt Judy before she got that operation.
She's from Uzbekistan.
And she's blonde and tall and pretty and fun
and smells like a fancy hotel bathroom!
My cousin Tanya smells like a gas station bathroom.
That's not the same thing.
Sam here yet?
No, she texted me from jail and said she'd be a few minutes late.
- Sam's in jail? - No, she's just visiting her cousin, Tanya.
Wow.
Yeah, this smells fantastic. Who gave me--
Hey, uh, hey, shut up a sec.
So listen, you know my cousin Dominic?
The guy with the nose?
Yeah.
His sister-in-law's father owns a restaurant supply company.
He said he can hook us up with anything we need.
Uh, menus, tables, kitchen appliances, food, meat, shrimp, lobster,
whatever we want. Super cheap.
- That's awesome. - Mm-hmm.
And last but not least, my crazy grandmother,
who we call Jamama!
Jamama!
She's actually half-horse.
What, a man can't drive 90 minutes
to surprise his favorite grandkids, huh?
How come my grandfather just sleeps and burps?
'Cause he's related to you?
A heart like a bull.
That's what they said about Sam's great-grandfather.
But then he died.
- Of a heart attack? - No, wrestling a bull.
Okay, on screen, you see a pic of Carly.
And a pic of Sam's rabid cat.
His name is Frothy.
- What do you think, Sam? - I'd morph that.
Then do it.
When people think of you, they don't think of fighting
and pranks and vicious behavior.
But that's who you are.
You're lovable and vicious.
Like your rabid cat, Frothy.
You hear that, Shelby Marks?
I could kick your butt.
Anytime, anywhere.
Let's go, Shelby.
She's just kidding.
Totally kidding.
Carly couldn't beat up my cat.
And her cat only has three legs.
Hey, Sam, remember when you were seven
and I told you that Fluffles ran away?
- Yeah. - I sold them.
Oh, my God.
You sold my bunny?
To foreigners.
